topics.label: Introduction to complement lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and frames the difficulty and scope of the complement system.

topics.label: Foundations, nomenclature, and central C3 mechanism of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational principles, naming conventions, and central role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways and trigger threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three pathways that initiate complement activation and converge on the trigger threshold.

topics.label: Downstream effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the primary effector functions triggered by complement activation to eliminate pathogens and mediate inflammation.

topics.label: Host cell regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host tissues from accidental complement attack.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct disease presentations and clinical consequences associated with deficiencies in various complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement and practical applications
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic covers the mechanisms pathogens evolve to circumvent complement and the practical applications derived from these evasion proteins.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and previews the upcoming lecture on the adaptive immune system.
